title: Moraine Lake's 3 Astonishing Features

scenes.text: Moraine Lake dazzles with 3 stunning traits you won’t believe!
scenes.query: Moraine Lake turquoise mountain lake sunrise

scenes.label: TURQUOISE HORIZON
scenes.text: The water’s crystal‑clear turquoise hue is fed by meltwater from the surrounding glaciers.
scenes.query: Moraine Lake glacial meltwater turquoise lake

scenes.label: HIDDEN PEAKS
scenes.text: Mount Temple and Mount Lefroy rise dramatically behind the lake, creating a dramatic backdrop.
scenes.query: Moraine Lake mountain peaks behind lake

scenes.label: GLOBE‑SHAPED ISLAND
scenes.text: An island in the middle of the lake mirrors the surrounding peaks, giving the illusion of a globe.
scenes.query: Moraine Lake lake island mirror mountains
